name: Telegram
readme_excerpt: Telegram messenger for Android Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security. It’s superfast, simple and free. This repo contains the official source code for Telegram App for Android. Creating your Telegram Application We welcome all developers to use our API and source code to create applications on our platform.
